common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.noAccess: You do not have access to this screen.

auth.signUpSubtitle: You will be the owner and can add your staff next.
auth.heroTitle: Run the room. See the kitchen.
auth.heroText: Reservations, floor plan and orders in one place. Every order reaches the kitchen the moment it is sent.
auth.heroFooter: Each restaurant sees only its own data. Access is checked on the server for every request.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Accounts for the people who use this restaurant's RistoManager.
staff.name: Name
staff.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out and unable to log in.
staff.ownerOnly: Only the owner can manage staff.
staff.resetDone: The password of {name} was changed. They were signed out everywhere.
staff.resetHint: Tell them the new password in person. They can change it under Account.

home.intro: Reservations, the floor plan and the kitchen screen arrive in the next steps.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.noTables: No table is free at this time for this many guests.
reservations.namePrompt: No name was entered. A reservation needs a name: use a generic one, or type the guest’s name.
reservations.phonePrompt: There is no phone number. If something changes you will not be able to reach the guest. Save anyway?

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Dishes and drinks, with the allergens they contain. The kitchen sees these allergens on every order.
menu.name: Name
menu.empty: The menu is empty. Add your first dish.
menu.readOnly: Only the owner and managers can change the menu.
menu.optionsHelp: Toppings, removals and variants that can be added to the dishes of one kind (for example pizzas). Each can have a price and the allergens it brings, which reach the kitchen’s allergy alarm.
menu.optionCourseHint: Only dishes of this kind can have it.
menu.optionSectionHint: Groups options, for example “Aggiunte” or “Senza e varianti”.
menu.optionsEmpty: No options yet. Add the first one.

floor.title: Floor plan
floor.emptyOwner: Create your first room to draw the floor plan.
floor.emptyOther: The floor plan has not been set up yet.
floor.nothingSelected: Tap a table or element to see its details.
floor.label: Label (optional)
floor.dragHint: Drag an item to move it. Select it to see handles: drag the sides to resize, the round knob above it to turn it. Drag the room’s right and bottom edges to stretch the room. Changes are saved when you let go.
floor.ownerOnlyEdit: Only the owner and managers can edit the floor plan.
floor.panHint: Drag the empty floor to move around. Click the plan, then Ctrl + scroll to zoom it.
floor.expandPlan: Expand the plan to fill the screen
floor.withoutTable: {count, plural, one {# reservation today has no table yet, so it cannot show on the plan.} other {# reservations today have no table yet, so they cannot show on the plan.}}
floor.draftHelp: Use a photo taken from above, or a photo of a sketch of the room. The result is a rough draft: you check it before anything is added.
floor.draftWidthHint: Used to draw the draft to scale.
floor.draftWidthInvalid: Enter a width between 1 and 200 metres.
floor.draftWorking: Reading the photo… this can take up to a minute.
floor.draftAddNote: These will be added to this room. Nothing already on the plan is changed or removed.
floor.draftUnreadable: This image could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
floor.draftNoItems: Nothing was found in the photo. Try a clearer photo taken from above.
floor.draftPreviewLabel: Draft of the room, {count, plural, one {# item shown} other {# items shown}}

orders.title: Orders
orders.nothingReady: Nothing is waiting to be served.
orders.menuEmpty: The menu is empty. Ask the owner to add dishes.
orders.confirmAllergy: This order has a dish with an allergen the guest declared ({list}). Send it anyway?
orders.servingHint: Dishes you add go into the selected serving. The kitchen sends them out one serving after the other.
orders.servingSummary: Serving {n}: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
orders.noOptions: There are no options for this kind of dish. You can still write a note.
orders.lineNoteHint: For example: no pepper, with ice
orders.errNoTable: Choose a table first: tap its number at the top.
orders.errEmptyOrder: The order is empty. Add at least one dish.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.allClear: No orders yet. New orders appear here the moment they are sent.

account.title: Account
account.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.recoveryIntro: Write two questions only you can answer. If you ever forget your password, answering both lets you set a new one. Without this, a forgotten owner password cannot be recovered.
account.recoveryOn: Recovery is set up. You can replace the questions below at any time.
account.recoveryOff: Recovery is not set up yet.
account.questionHint: Pick something that cannot be found on your social media. Capitals and accents do not matter in the answer.
account.confirmWithPassword: Enter your current password to confirm
account.bannerText: If you forget your password, there is currently no way back in.
account.lookHelp: Choose the colours and lettering for everyone in the restaurant.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Owners can set a new password by answering the two questions they chose.
recover.done: Password changed. You can sign in now.
recover.notOwner: Staff accounts cannot recover themselves: ask your restaurant's owner to set a new password for you.
recover.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted, and are kept for {days} days.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.help: Ask about bookings, tables, the kitchen queue or the menu. Booking and cancelling need your confirmation.

suggestions.freeTables: Which tables are free right now?
suggestions.kitchenQueue: What is in the kitchen queue?
suggestions.bookExample: Book a table for 4 tomorrow at 20:00

assistant.thinking: Thinking… this can take up to a minute.
assistant.error: The assistant could not answer. Please try again.
assistant.failedGone: This proposal has expired. Ask again.
assistant.failedNetwork: The connection was lost, so we do not know if it was done. Check the reservations before asking again.
assistant.failedGeneric: That could not be done. Please try again.

notices.ALLERGEN_CONFIRM_WITH_KITCHEN: Allergens: always confirm with the kitchen.
notices.SAFETY_CLAIM_REMOVED: The assistant cannot confirm that a dish is safe for an allergy. Ask the kitchen.
notices.TOO_MANY_STEPS: The assistant could not finish. Try asking in a different way.
notices.NOTHING_CHANGED: Nothing was changed. Try the request again.
